operations.name: Paid scale window (baseline handling)
operations.description: Fund a ten-minute workload measurement with the customer's ordinary handling model. It can fail when the measured queue cannot complete enough eligible work.

operations.name: Paid scale workflow and BPO handling
operations.description: Fund a short, consented service workflow for a measured window; separately purchase the existing two-person BPO offer before ordering. Ordinary campaign demand remains in the same observer denominator.

operations.name: Managed sustained workload
operations.description: After earning the staffed TB workload milestone, fund a managed one-minute service workflow for a measured window; separately purchase the existing two-person BPO offer before ordering. Lower setup and engineering demand trade against higher recurring cost.
